description: Reads the current stored review status of one RoboDebut submission, identified by the secret status_receipt returned only to the request that created it. Has no homepage or email lookup and cannot recover legacy or lost receipts; public approval is also visible on RoboDebut's public pages. Does not recheck the homepage, submit, edit, approve, notify or contact other services. Returns a status. The outcome determines whether the response includes a plain-language human_message, a public listing URL or a retry delay.

status_receipt.description: Secret receipt from the original submission response. Accepted only as a tool argument.

name: get_submission_status
title: Check your submission status
